boss:1.text: Simon Randall,[R 2] better known as Royce, is the leader of the Maelstrom gang in Cyberpunk 2077. During The Ride, the fixer Dexter DeShawn tasks V and Jackie Welles with acquiring a stolen Militech bot called the Flathead from Royce's gang located in the All Foods Factory. The Pickup job can be completed in a variety of ways that lead to different outcomes for Royce:

boss:2.text: Matilda has been the alpha animal of her pack since 2075. Her expertise includes heavy melee combat and her weapon of choice was an oversized unique sledgehammer by the name of Sasquatch's Hammer, created specifically for her. In 2077, Matilda was known well enough throughout Night City to attract contractors as big as NetWatch.

boss:3.text: Sandayu Oda (Japanese: 小田 三太夫, Hepburn: Oda Sandayu) is a solo and cyberninja employed by the Arasaka Corporation, assigned as the personal bodyguard of Hanako Arasaka. He specializes in martial arts and utilizes Arasaka Mantis Blades in combat. Upon being admitted to the Arasaka ranks, Oda had been trained by Goro Takemura as a highly skilled fighter.

collectible:2.text: Upon approaching the location, a NCPD officer will be shot. Nearby bodies have suffered the same fate, being rifle shots from the back. During combat, the cyberpsycho will shoot and run from hiding spot, occasionally lobbing bombs. Upon defeat and searching the surroundings, V finds a laptop hiding in a storage crate containing the necessary information to report to Regina Jones.
